nodes.body:
What is Galaxy Pool?
Galaxy Pool is a single player 2D puzzle game, inspired by cue sports and space physics.  Each level is a solar system or galaxy, filled with various celestial bodies and a local black hole. These celestial bodies are in an equilibrious orbit. Until the player uses their intergalactic pool cue to hit a celestial body. 

It’s also an immersive sim where you get to figure out how to win in a way the designers didn’t even predict!

Gameplay loop
By hitting one celestial body with your intergalactic cue, you must use gravity and momentum in order to put as many celestial bodies into the local black hole as you can. After the remaining celestial bodies have settled, you can go again. As many times until all celestial bodies have been consumed by the black hole. The level is scored, based on the number of celestial bodies placed into the black hole and the number of cue hits required. Each level has a maximum number of cue ‘hits’ that the player has to finish the level (just like in golf). Fewer hits equals higher score. A player can lose celestial bodies in the process, reducing their score. This can happen when a planet is destroyed when it hits a sun, for example.
